meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 在 migrate-v2.sh 跑完后接手收尾:读取 handoff.json,修补失败步骤、给账号授予 owner 角色、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置,并帮忙搬运 v1 的自定义改动。
howto.when: 当你提到“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”等关键词,或在 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 跑完、需要收尾这次迁移时触发。

say.text: 迁移脚本已经跑完了,帮我完成剩下的 v1 到 v2 迁移。
say.note: 它会先读 handoff.json,再分阶段接手。

say.text: 帮我确认一下 v2 的 owner 账号设好了没有。
say.note: 它会查 users 表并核对 owner 角色。

say.text: 我在 v1 里改过一些自定义代码,帮我看怎么搬到 v2。
say.note: 它会检查 v1 仓库的提交记录。

howto.what_en: After migrate-v2.sh finishes, it takes over: reads handoff.json, fixes failed steps, grants the owner role, runs the shared-memory migration, reconciles container configs, and helps move custom v1 code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from v1", "finish migration", etc., or after you run `bash migrate-v2.sh` and need the migration finished.

say_en.text: The migration script already ran — finish the rest of the v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: Reads handoff.json, then works phase by phase.

say_en.text: Check whether the v2 owner account is set up correctly.
say_en.note: Queries the users table and checks the owner role.

say_en.text: I customized some v1 code — show me how to port it to v2.
say_en.note: Inspects the v1 repo's commit history.
